bio.text: Alex Rizo represents Florida House District 112; Rizo was elected to the Florida House in 2020 and reelected subsequently.
According to the House's biography, Rizo is an educator and small business owner who lives in Hialeah; Rizo was born in New York City and moved to Florida in 1968.

Rizo holds a bachelor's degree in biological sciences from Florida International University and a master's degree in educational leadership and administration from Nova Southeastern University, and served as vice chair of Miami-Dade Community Council 5 from 2015 to 2020.
